panels.title: Critical firing
panels.description: From PrometheusRule edb-postgres-alerts (ALERTS series). Empty = rules not deployed or nothing firing.

panels.title: Warnings firing
panels.description: From PrometheusRule edb-postgres-alerts (ALERTS series). Empty = rules not deployed or nothing firing.

panels.title: Pending
panels.description: Condition true, 'for' duration not yet elapsed.

panels.title: Active alerts
panels.description:
From PrometheusRule edb-postgres-alerts (ALERTS series). Empty = rules not deployed or nothing firing.

- **severity**: critical = act now, warning = investigate soon, info = no action needed.
- **alertname**: Name of the Prometheus rule (manifests/edb-postgres-alerts.yaml).
- **pod**: Instance the alert refers to. Empty for cluster-wide alerts (backups, primary election).
- **datname**: Database the alert refers to, if any.

panels.title: Alert history (firing)
panels.description: From PrometheusRule edb-postgres-alerts (ALERTS series). Empty = rules not deployed or nothing firing.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity, pod) (ALERTS{component="edb-postgres", namespace="$namespace", job="$job", alertstate="firing"}) or on () label_replace(vector(0), "alertname", "no alerts", "", "")

panels.title: Instances ready
panels.description: cnp_collector_up: 1 if PostgreSQL answers the exporter.

panels.title: Primary
panels.description: Pod with pg_is_in_recovery() = false. Empty = failover in progress or replica cluster.

panels.title: Postgres version
panels.description: PostgreSQL version from cnp_collector_postgres_version (label 'full'). Two versions at once only during a rolling minor upgrade.

panels.title: Nodes used
panels.description: Distinct k8s nodes hosting the instances. 1 = no HA (all pods on one node). -1 = unknown.

panels.title: Sync replicas
panels.description: observed < expected = synchronous replication degraded (writes may block).

panels.title: Since newest restart
panels.description: Uptime of the most recently (re)started instance.

panels.title: Flags
panels.description: Fencing: instance deliberately stopped (k8s.enterprisedb.io/fencedInstances). Switchover req.: operator waits for a manual switchover (primaryUpdateStrategy: supervised). Exporter error: the last monitoring query failed, other panels may be stale. Replica mode: the whole cluster replicates from another cluster (expected for DR clusters).

panels.title: Instances
panels.description:
One row per pod.

- **pod**: Pod name of the instance (<cluster>-<n>).
- **Up**: up = PostgreSQL answers the instance manager (cnp_collector_up).
- **Role**: primary = accepts writes; replica = streaming standby (pg_is_in_recovery()).
- **Replay lag**: Seconds the replica is behind the primary. 0 on the primary. Orange from 60 s, red from 300 s.
- **Backends**: Client connections (pg_stat_activity) on this instance.
- **Conn. used**: Backends / max_connections. Orange from 80 %, red from 95 %.
- **pg_wal**: Size of WAL segments on disk (pg_wal directory).
- **Uptime**: Time since the postmaster on this instance started.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (cnp_backends_total{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}) / on (pod) max by (pod) (cnp_pg_settings_setting{namespace="$namespace", job="$job", name="max_connections"})

panels.title: Backends by state
panels.description: pg_stat_activity client backends, all instances.

panels.title: Connections used (% of max_connections)
panels.description: Client backends per instance divided by max_connections. Warning at 80 %, critical at 95 % (CNPConnectionsNearLimit). At 100 % new connections are refused.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (cnp_backends_total{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}) / on (pod) max by (pod) (cnp_pg_settings_setting{namespace="$namespace", job="$job", name="max_connections"})

panels.title: Longest open transaction
panels.description: Alert CNPLongRunningTransaction at 300 s. Long transactions block vacuum and bloat tables.

panels.title: Transactions / s
panels.description: Commits and rollbacks per second over all databases and instances. A growing rollback share points to application errors or serialization conflicts.

panels.title: Tuples / s
panels.description: Row operations per second (pg_stat_database). fetched/returned = reads, inserted/updated/deleted = writes. returned much larger than fetched hints at sequential scans.

panels.title: Lock-blocked backends
panels.description: Backends waiting on a lock held by another backend (pg_locks). Alert CNPBackendsBlockedOnLocks at >10 for 5 m.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: max across instances (replicas hold the same data, summing would multiply it).

panels.title: pg_wal usage
panels.description: WAL segments on disk vs. size of the volume holding pg_wal. Full pg_wal = PostgreSQL stops. Usually caused by failing archiving or a stale replication slot.

targets.expr: max by (pod) (cnp_collector_pg_wal{namespace="$namespace", job="$job", value="size"}) / max by (pod) (cnp_collector_pg_wal{namespace="$namespace", job="$job", value="volume_size"})

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Current (rate-based) shared_buffers hit ratio. OLTP target > 99 %.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(cnp_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (pod) (rate(cnp_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (pod) (rate(cnp_pg_stat_database_blks_read{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Block reads / s
panels.description: Blocks read from disk vs. served from shared_buffers per second. Sustained high disk reads = working set larger than memory.

panels.title: Temp files written
panels.description: Sorts/hashes spilling to disk. Persistent values = work_mem too small or bad queries.

panels.title: WAL generated
panels.description: pg_stat_wal.wal_bytes (PG 14+). Drives archive volume and replication bandwidth.

panels.title: Replica replay lag
panels.description: now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() on replicas; 0 when caught up.

panels.title: Replication lag (bytes, from primary)
panels.description: WAL not yet replayed per standby, measured on the primary (pg_stat_replication). Byte view of the replay lag.

panels.title: Replication slot WAL retention
panels.description: WAL kept back by each slot on the primary. Growing line = consumer gone, pg_wal fills up.

targets.expr: max by (slot_name) (cnp_pg_replication_slots_pg_wal_lsn_diff{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"} and on (namespace, pod) cnp_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"} == 0)

panels.title: Checkpoints / h
panels.description: PG 17+ pg_stat_checkpointer, older pg_stat_bgwriter. Many 'requested' = max_wal_size too small.

panels.title: Transaction ID age
panels.description: Wraparound protection forces read-only at ~2.1 B. Alert warning 300 M / critical 1 B.

panels.title: Deadlocks & conflicts / h
panels.description: Deadlocks per hour (alert CNPDeadlocks above 10/h) and recovery conflicts: queries on replicas cancelled because WAL replay needed the rows.

panels.title: Extensions with updates available
panels.description:
Run ALTER EXTENSION ... UPDATE after operand upgrades.

- **datname**: Database the extension is installed in.
- **extname**: Extension name.
- **installed_version**: Version currently installed in the database.
- **default_version**: Version shipped with the running PostgreSQL image. Run ALTER EXTENSION ... UPDATE.

targets.expr: max by (datname, extname, installed_version, default_version) (cnp_pg_extensions_update_available{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}) == 1

panels.title: Since last backup
panels.description: Newest *_last_available_backup_timestamp (in-core cnp_collector or Barman Cloud plugin). Details: backup dashboard.

panels.title: Last backup failed
panels.description: YES = newest failed backup is younger than the newest successful one (alert CNPLastBackupFailed). Clears with the next successful backup. n/a = no backup metrics.

panels.title: WAL archiving failing
panels.description: YES = last archive_command failure on the primary is newer than the last success (alert CNPWALArchivingFailing). Point-in-time recovery is broken while YES.

targets.expr: max((cnp_pg_stat_archiver_last_failed_time{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"} - cnp_pg_stat_archiver_last_archived_time{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}) > bool 1 and on (namespace, pod) cnp_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"} == 0)

panels.title: WAL waiting for archive
panels.description: .ready files in pg_wal/archive_status. Alert CNPWALArchiveBacklog > 20 for 15 m.

panels.title: Aktive Alarme
panels.description:
Aus PrometheusRule edb-postgres-alerts (ALERTS-Serie). Leer = Regeln nicht deployed oder nichts aktiv.

- **severity**: critical = sofort handeln, warning = zeitnah pruefen, info = keine Aktion.
- **alertname**: Name der Prometheus-Regel (manifests/edb-postgres-alerts.yaml).
- **pod**: Betroffene Instanz. Leer bei clusterweiten Alarmen (Backup, Primary-Wahl).

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity, pod) (ALERTS{component="edb-postgres", namespace="$namespace", job="$job", alertname=~"CNP(Backup|LastBackup|NoBackup|WAL).*", alertstate="firing"}) or on () label_replace(vector(0), "alertname", "no alerts", "", "")

panels.title: Seit letztem Backup
panels.description: Alter des juengsten verfuegbaren Backups (Object Store oder Volume Snapshot). Annahme taegliches ScheduledBackup: gelb ab 26 h, rot ab 50 h (= Alarme CNPBackupTooOld / CNPBackupMissing).

panels.title: Letztes Backup fehlgeschlagen?
panels.description: JA = letzter Fehlversuch ist juenger als das letzte erfolgreiche Backup.

panels.title: Restore-Fenster (PITR)
panels.description: Abstand zum fruehesten Wiederherstellungspunkt = wie weit zurueck PITR moeglich ist. Sollte etwa der retentionPolicy entsprechen.

panels.title: Letztes Backup
panels.description: Zeitpunkt des juengsten erfolgreichen Backups (Browser-Zeitzone).

panels.title: Letzter Fehlversuch
panels.description: Zeitpunkt des letzten fehlgeschlagenen Backups. 'nie' = bisher kein Fehler. Aelter als 'Letztes Backup' = Fehler ist bereits ueberholt.

panels.title: Metrik-Quelle
panels.description: Gefundene *_last_available_backup_timestamp-Metriken: cnp_collector_* (in-core, deprecated) und/oder Barman-Cloud-Plugin. Keine = kein Backup konfiguriert oder Plugin-Sidecar nicht gescrapt.

panels.title: Archivierung fehlerhaft?
panels.description: JA = letzter archive_command-Fehler juenger als letzte erfolgreiche Archivierung (= Alarm CNPWALArchivingFailing).

targets.expr: max((cnp_pg_stat_archiver_last_failed_time{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"} - cnp_pg_stat_archiver_last_archived_time{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"}) > bool 1 and on (namespace, pod) cnp_pg_replication_in_recovery{namespace="$namespace", job="$job"} == 0)

panels.title: Seit letzter WAL-Archivierung
panels.description: archive_timeout ist bei EDB/CNPG 5 min. Hohe Werte bei voellig idle DB sind normal.

panels.title: WAL wartet auf Archivierung
panels.description: .ready-Dateien in pg_wal/archive_status. Waechst die Zahl, kommt die Archivierung nicht hinterher oder schlaegt fehl.

panels.title: WAL-Archivfehler (24 h)
panels.description: Fehlgeschlagene archive_command-Aufrufe in 24 h. Einzelne Fehler mit erfolgreichem Retry sind unkritisch; nur zusammen mit 'Archivierung fehlerhaft? = JA' ein Problem.

panels.title: pg_wal Belegung
panels.description: Volles pg_wal-Volume stoppt PostgreSQL. Typische Ursache: Archivierung defekt.

panels.title: Archivierte Segmente (24 h)
panels.description: In 24 h ins Object Store geschriebene WAL-Segmente (je 16 MiB). Mass fuer WAL-Aufkommen und Speicherbedarf der Backups.

panels.title: Alter des letzten Backups
panels.description: Saegezahn = gesund. Linie steigt ohne Reset = Backups laufen nicht.

panels.title: Restore-Fenster
panels.description: Abstand zwischen fruehestem Wiederherstellungspunkt und jetzt. Faellt die Kurve, hat die retentionPolicy alte Backups geloescht; waechst sie unbegrenzt, greift keine Retention.

panels.title: WAL-Archivierung / h
panels.description: Archivierte (gruen) und fehlgeschlagene (rot) WAL-Segmente pro Stunde.

panels.title: WAL archive_status (ready / done)
panels.description: ready = wartet auf Archivierung (Alarm ab 20), done = archiviert, wird beim naechsten Checkpoint aufgeraeumt.

panels.title: pg_wal Belegung
panels.description: Groesse von pg_wal gegen die Groesse des WAL-Volumes (gestrichelt). Erreicht die Linie das Volume, stoppt PostgreSQL.

list.label: Datasource
list.description: Prometheus (or Thanos Querier) datasource holding the ALERTS series.

list.name: scope
list.label: Scope
list.description: EDB Postgres = only rules labelled component=edb-postgres. All alerts = every Prometheus alert (Kubernetes, nodes, ...).

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: Namespaces that had alerts in the selected time range. All = every namespace.

list.name: severity
list.label: Severity
list.description: Filter by alert severity. critical = act now, warning = investigate soon, info = no action.

panels.title: Critical
panels.description: Firing alerts with severity=critical in the current scope. Needs action now. Source: Prometheus ALERTS series (rules deployed as PrometheusRule). Rules imported into Grafana appear only in the Alert inbox.

panels.title: Warning
panels.description: Firing alerts with severity=warning. Investigate soon. Source: Prometheus ALERTS series (rules deployed as PrometheusRule). Rules imported into Grafana appear only in the Alert inbox.

panels.title: Info
panels.description: Informational alerts (e.g. PostgreSQL restarted). No action required. Source: Prometheus ALERTS series (rules deployed as PrometheusRule). Rules imported into Grafana appear only in the Alert inbox.

panels.title: Pending
panels.description: Condition true, 'for' duration not yet reached. Becomes firing if it persists.

panels.title: Affected namespaces
panels.description: Namespaces with at least one firing alert. Source: Prometheus ALERTS series (rules deployed as PrometheusRule). Rules imported into Grafana appear only in the Alert inbox.

panels.title: Oldest active alert
panels.description: How long the longest-running alert has been active.

panels.title: Alert inbox (expand an alert for summary / description)
panels.description: Every firing/pending alert, whether Prometheus evaluates the rule (PrometheusRule) or Grafana does (rules imported into Grafana). 'View alert rule' opens the rule with its query and history.

panels.title: Active alerts
panels.description:
One row per active alert instance. 'active since' comes from ALERTS_FOR_STATE.

- **severity**: critical = act now, warning = investigate soon, info = no action needed.
- **alertname**: Name of the Prometheus rule (manifests/edb-postgres-alerts.yaml).
- **pod**: Instance the alert refers to. Empty for cluster-wide alerts (backups, primary election).
- **alertstate**: FIRING = condition held for the rule's 'for' duration. pending = condition true, 'for' not yet reached.
- **namespace**: Kubernetes namespace of the affected workload.
- **active since**: When the condition first became true (ALERTS_FOR_STATE), including the pending phase.
- **duration**: Time since 'active since'.
- **what it means / what to do**: Description of the rule; <label> placeholders refer to the columns on the left.

targets.expr: (ALERTS_FOR_STATE{component=~"$scope", severity=~"$severity", namespace=~"$namespace"} + ignoring (alertstate) group_right () (ALERTS{component=~"$scope", severity=~"$severity", namespace=~"$namespace"} * 0)) * 1000

time() - (ALERTS_FOR_STATE{component=~"$scope", severity=~"$severity", namespace=~"$namespace"} + ignoring (alertstate) group_right () (ALERTS{component=~"$scope", severity=~"$severity", namespace=~"$namespace"} * 0))

label_replace((ALERTS_FOR_STATE{component=~"$scope", severity=~"$severity", namespace=~"$namespace"} + ignoring (alertstate) group_right () (ALERTS{component=~"$scope", severity=~"$severity", namespace=~"$namespace"} * 0)), "action", "$1", "alertname", "(.*)")

renameByName.action: what it means / what to do

matcher.options: what it means / what to do

CNPInstanceDown.text: The instance manager cannot reach PostgreSQL on <pod> (cluster <cluster>).

CNPMetricsTargetDown.text: Prometheus cannot scrape port 9187 of <pod>. Pod down, TLS mismatch on the PodMonitor, or NetworkPolicy.

CNPNoPrimary.text: All instances are in recovery and the cluster is not in replica mode. Writes are failing.

CNPMultiplePrimaries.text: More than one instance is out of recovery (split brain). Check `kubectl cnp status`.

CNPFencingActive.text: Fencing is on; PostgreSQL on this instance is stopped. Remove the k8s.enterprisedb.io/fencedInstances annotation when done.

CNPManualSwitchoverRequired.text: The operator needs a manual switchover to proceed (e.g. primaryUpdateStrategy: supervised).

CNPNoHighAvailability.text: A single node failure takes down the whole cluster. Check pod anti-affinity.

CNPMetricsCollectionError.text: At least one monitoring query errors. Dashboards/alerts based on it are blind. Check instance logs for 'cnp_metrics_exporter'.

CNPPostgresRestarted.text: Postmaster restarted inside the running pod in the last 15 minutes (crash recovery, config reload with restart, promotion).

CNPReplicationLag.text: Standby is lagging behind the primary by more than 5 minutes.

CNPReplicationLagCritical.text: Standby is lagging behind the primary by more than 15 minutes. A failover now loses data.

CNPReplicaNotStreaming.text: Instance is in recovery but has no WAL receiver. Expected only on a replica cluster's designated primary restoring from object store.

CNPSyncReplicasDegraded.text: Synchronous replication is degraded. Depending on dataDurability, commits block or durability is reduced.

CNPReplicationSlotInactive.text: An inactive slot on the primary retains WAL indefinitely and will fill pg_wal.

CNPReplicationSlotWALRetention.text: Slot consumer is far behind or gone.

CNPLongRunningTransaction.text: db=<datname> user=<usename> app=<application_name>. Long transactions block vacuum.

CNPBackendsBlockedOnLocks.text: More than 10 backends have been waiting on locks held by other sessions for 5 minutes.

CNPConnectionsNearLimit.text: New connections will be refused when the limit is reached. Consider a Pooler (PgBouncer).

CNPConnectionsNearLimitCritical.text: Connections are about to be refused.

CNPXIDWraparoundRisk.text: Over 300M transactions since the oldest unfrozen XID. Check autovacuum and long transactions.

CNPXIDWraparoundCritical.text: Halfway to wraparound shutdown (~2.1B). Run VACUUM FREEZE now.

CNPDeadlocks.text: More than 10 deadlocks in the last hour.

CNPWALVolumeFillingUp.text: Usually failing WAL archiving or an inactive replication slot.

CNPWALVolumeFillingUpCritical.text: PostgreSQL stops when pg_wal is full.

CNPWALArchivingFailing.text: Last archive attempt failed and no success since. PITR is broken and pg_wal is filling up. Check object-store credentials/reachability.

CNPWALArchiveBacklog.text: Archiving is not keeping up with WAL generation.

CNPBackupTooOld.text: No successful backup in 26h. Assumes a daily ScheduledBackup.

CNPLastBackupFailed.text: The last failed backup is newer than the last successful one. `kubectl get backups -n <namespace>`.

CNPNoBackupEver.text: Backup metrics exist but report no completed backup for 26h. Missing ScheduledBackup or broken object store.

panels.title: Firing alerts over time

targets.expr: max by (alertname, namespace, pod) (ALERTS{component=~"$scope", severity=~"$severity", namespace=~"$namespace", alertstate="firing"}) or on () label_replace(vector(0), "alertname", "no alerts", "", "")

panels.description: One row per alert instance; red = firing, empty = not firing. Hover for start and end. Source: Prometheus ALERTS series (rules deployed as PrometheusRule). Rules imported into Grafana appear only in the Alert inbox.

panels.title: Firing alerts by severity
panels.description: Number of firing alerts per severity over time (stacked). Peaks mark incident windows. Source: Prometheus ALERTS series (rules deployed as PrometheusRule). Rules imported into Grafana appear only in the Alert inbox.

panels.title: Top alerts by time firing

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (alertname) (count_over_time(ALERTS{component=~"$scope", severity=~"$severity", namespace=~"$namespace", alertstate="firing"}[$__range:1m])))

panels.description: Sum over all instances of an alert, 1-minute resolution.

panels.title: Alert log
panels.description:
Every alert instance that fired in the selected range (1-minute resolution). Range limited by Prometheus retention.

- **severity**: critical = act now, warning = investigate soon, info = no action needed.
- **alertname**: Name of the Prometheus rule (manifests/edb-postgres-alerts.yaml).
- **pod**: Instance the alert refers to. Empty for cluster-wide alerts (backups, primary election).
- **status**: FIRING = still firing at the end of the time range; resolved = not firing any more.
- **namespace**: Kubernetes namespace of the affected workload.
- **first seen**: First minute the alert was firing within the selected time range.
- **last seen**: Last minute the alert was firing within the selected time range.
- **minutes firing**: Minutes in firing state within the selected time range (1-minute resolution).
